I have over 10 years of experience working on climate change and energy, with the last 6 years focused on heavy industry decarbonization. I currently lead Global Energy Monitor's Heavy Industry Program, overseeing a global team working across the iron and steel, cement, chemicals, and raw materials sectors.

Selected areas of expertise are highlighted below. See my [CV](Caitlin_Swalec_CV_01_22_2025.pdf) for my full professional and academic experience.

+--------------------------------+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ### *Leadership*               |        | Director of Global Energy Monitor's Heavy Industry Program, managing a global team and portfolio of research projects spanning multiple industrial sectors. Experience in strategy, supervision, hiring, project management, and mentoring more than ten staff ranging from entry-level researchers to PhD-level professionals at once. |
+--------------------------------+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ### *Communications and media* |        | Regularly communicate complex technical topics to journalists and reporters from outlets including CNN, the Financial Times, DW, South China Morning Post, Fastmarkets, and Canary Media. Published in industry outlets including GreenBiz, RENEW-Industry, and Steel Times International.                                              |

| ### *Fundraising*              |        | Lead fundraising and grant management for GEM's Heavy Industry Program, securing more than \$1.75 million annually for research initiatives, from dozens of funders including multi-year renewals.                                                                                                                                      |
+--------------------------------+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ### *Engineering*              |        | Training and professional experience in air quality control and permitting, offshore wind farm planning, and chemical and industrial plant design. This technical background informs my understanding of the practical challenges of deploying industrial decarbonization technologies.                                                 |
